entities.summary: Isabel Maria Adrian Angello is a Swedish television personality, producer, author and model. She was a contestant in Expedition Robinson 2004 which was broadcast on TV3 and also made a centerfold in the men's magazine Café in the same year. Adrian has worked as a model. She is a well-known Swedish and international blogger and a clothing designer.
